notes.title: Dorian Morris Adventure - Patch #1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33705601/1bad8a5299703f252fe0099408fe28b487596347.png[/img]

[b]Hello Dorian Morris Adventure community![/b]

first of all, we are very grateful for the kind welcome for our game. 

We got a lot of positive feedback, as well as a lot of ideas to make Dorian Morris Adventure a better game. Because of it, we give you first Patch, which fixes some critical issues.

[list]
    [*]Fixed problem with saving - Now the game saves every time you change the room you are in.
    [*]Fixed problem with the polish version of an outro when you choose the English version of the game 
    [*]Minor translation problems
    [*]Minor bug fixing.
[/list]

[b]We will keep you posted about the next Dorian Morris Adventure updates [/b]

Have fun and stay safe!

notes.title: Dorian Morris Adventure is out on Steam
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33705601/447022f50ad6f3585df7e9ad52ab529cdf6c69ee.jpg[/img]

Dear Dorian Morris Comunity,

The final day of our journey finally comes - Dorian Morris Adventure is out! 

This was a couple of months full of ups and downs, but we are delighted with the final result of our work. [b]Dorian Morris Adventure[/b] is not only an entertaining experience but also mind training and a powerful dose of practical and useful knowledge in life.

This is a big day for the whole Forestlight Games team, Dorian Morris Adventure is our first Fully original project that went to the official sale. A lot to come, but Dorian Morris will always stay in our hearts and company history.

[b]17 November 2020, at 13:00 CET we will host a special Dorian Morris Adventure dev stream. Remember to join and have fun![/b]

[b]We hope you will like our game as much as we do. [/b]

[h2]You can get [b]Dorian Morris Adventure[/b] now with a special 15% launch discount, but be fast. Its limited time deal.[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/898490/Dorian_Morris_Adventure

notes.title: Dorian Morris Adventure - Release date!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33705601/f68bdf062dca18b30502c0fe7f0ee4ccf9e04e53.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hello Dorian Morris Community![/h1]

We hope you all doing well and healthy. 

After long months of waiting, finally, you will be able to discover the secrets of Dorian Morris world, why is grandfather missing, and how he's connected to the Book of Knowledge 

We are honored and happy to announce that the full version [b]Dorian Morris Adventure[/b] is coming to Steam on [u][b]16th November 2020[/b][/u]

PS. Dorian Morris demo is still available to download. Be sure to check it out before the full version release

notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33705601/7a4fd71c44daeeccc95a147181251faa8c899079.jpg[/img]

[h2]Hi, everyone![/h2]

We are happy to announce that we are still working to give you a chance to challenge yourself. The full version of the game will be in your hands soon.
